title: Renew or restore a commercial agent licence – individual/sole trader
summary: This page explains how to renew or restore your individual or sole trader commercial agent licence with NSW Fair Trading.
intro:
If you're currently licensed as a commercial agent with NSW Fair Trading, you'll be emailed a renewal notice about 60 days prior to the licence expiring. You're then able to renew your licence online.

If your NSW Fair Trading licence has expired and it is:

You can renew or restore for 1, 3 or 5 years.
who_can_apply: Hold a current commercial agent licence that is due for renewal.
Be a fit and proper person to hold a licence.
Not be an undischarged bankrupt or taking benefit of bankruptcy laws.
Not have an exclusion order that prohibits commercial agent activity.
Not have a NSW commercial agent licence that is currently cancelled, disqualified, or suspended.
Not be a controlled member of a declared organisation under the Crimes (Criminal Organisations Control) Act 2012.

Not have been convicted of a relevant offence (including violence, harassment, intimidation, weapons, drugs, and dishonesty) within the last 5 years that resulted in a prison sentence or a fine of $500 or more.
what_you_need: Your renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice).
A copy of your current National Police Check (PDF, JPG, or PNG format).

how_to_steps.text: Gather the required details and documents.
Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to renew or restore your licence.
1 or 3-year licence and your previous licence photo was taken over 5 years ago

more_info.text: If you have not received a renewal notice within 60 days of your licence expiry date, call 13 32 20.
You can continue to use your existing card until you receive your new one.
You need to destroy your old licence card after you've received your new card.
To look up your commercial agent licence number and details, visit Verify NSW.

faqs.q: How far in advance do I receive notice about renewing my licence?
faqs.a: You will be emailed a renewal notice about 60 days before your licence expires.

faqs.q: What are the options for renewing or restoring my licence?
faqs.a: You can renew or restore your licence for 1, 3, or 5 years.

faqs.q: What are the eligibility requirements to renew or restore my licence?
faqs.a: You must hold a current licence due for renewal and be a fit and proper person. You are ineligible if you are an undischarged bankrupt, have an exclusion order, or have been convicted of certain relevant offences.
